## Known Limitations and Notes

1. **Integration Test Cases (INT-01, INT-02, INT-03):**
   - Marked as PARTIAL automation candidates due to multi-app navigation requirements
   - Automation viability depends on Playwright's ability to maintain Fiori session state across multiple applications
   - Manual execution may be required if cross-app automation is not feasible

2. **Cleanroom/Sterile Manufacturing Context:**
   - All test data must use cleanroom/sterile work centers and pharmaceutical/medical device materials
   - Test execution must be performed in dedicated test system instances (not production)
   - GMP compliance requirements mandate accurate changeover time enforcement and capacity overload prevention

3. **Test Data Dependencies:**
   - All test data values use `{TD.*}` and `{ENV.*}` placeholders — no hardcoded SAP values
   - Test data JSON (`CS-61-testdata.json`) and guide (`CS-61-testdata-guide.md`) must be populated with valid SAP system values before test execution

4. **Real-time Data Synchronization:**
   - Integration test cases assume near-real-time or immediate data synchronization between modules
   - If synchronization delays exist in the SAP system, integration test cases may require wait periods or manual refresh actions
